raw_context:
Sugi Holdings sells and distributes thousands of
Japanese pharmaceutical, healthcare, beauty, and daily living goods
through its retail arm,
Sugi Pharmacy
, and its international wholesale trading subsidiary,
S Trading
. Rather than focusing on a single exclusive manufacturer, they distribute a vast cross-section of mainstream Japanese consumer goods alongside their own in-house label.
Sトレーディング
Product Categories and Inventories
Sugi Group Private Brand ("S Select"):
Over 1,000 original and private-label products developed directly by the Sugi Group, ranging from wellness items to household goods.
Healthcare & Supplements:
Over 1,000 products, including vitamins, functional supplements, green juice (
Aojiru
), and hygiene items.
Pharmaceuticals:
Over 300 over-the-counter lines, including standard gastrointestinal remedies, pain-relieving medicated patches, and common cold medications.
Beauty & Cosmetics:
Over 1,000 items, covering skincare, makeup, and cosmetic application tools.
Home Care & Daily Necessities:
Over 3,000 goods, such as household detergents, room fresheners, and oral care products like toothbrushes.
Foods & Confectionery:
Over 1,000 items, featuring popular Japanese snacks, beverages, and light food provisions.
Distribution and Partnerships
Through
S Trading
, Sugi acts as a primary trade intermediary connecting Japanese third-party manufacturers and wholesalers with major pharmacy and retail chains across Asia (such as in Taiwan, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Thailand). They also collaborate with regional joint-venture partners like
Sugi Aishodo
to distribute specialized cosmetics and healthcare lines.
